title: Chapter 214: Calling For Help
content:
Chapter 214: Calling For Help

People's hearts seem insignificant at certain moments, but they are extremely important at certain moments. Today's Wei State is an extremely important moment.

The state of Wei has been weak for hundreds of years. In these hundreds of years, the defeat of one war after another has completely lost the confidence of the state of Wei.

Under such circumstances, especially Qin State, forcibly beat Wei State into a cripple. Most of Wei State's territory was taken away by Qin State, so that when Wei State was ordering against Qin State , There is always some lack of confidence in my heart.

Even though the situation in the world is very good now, the joint vertical coalition forces are constantly marching forward, regaining their territory originally occupied by Qin State, and pushing Qin State's sphere of influence back to the vicinity of Hangu Pass again.

Among them, Wei State benefited the most. Not only did it regain all the territories it had lost, but it also invaded the original Hanoi County in South Korea, truly expanding its territory.

Now there is only one Hedong County, and a small area centered on Anyi City, which has not been won.

Moreover, the confidence and fighting spirit of Wei's army gradually recovered in the continuous victories, and they were not as vulnerable as before.

But in the final analysis, they still have a fear from the bottom of their hearts towards the Qin people.

This is not a psychological reason, but a legacy that has been passed down to their blood because of their ancestors' defeats from generation to generation.

If they want to restore their confidence, they must do something that makes them think that they have defeated Qin and revitalized Wei.

Well, such a significant event, what could compare to recovering the old capital, completely driving the Qin people back to the west of the Yellow River, and completely blocking them in Hangu Pass!

Thinking about these trivial things in his heart, King Wei became even more irritable. Now this feeling of powerlessness displeased King Wei, whose heart began to swell because of the victory all the way. He hated this feeling of not being able to control everything.

Suddenly, a loud report came from outside the tent: "Report, report to Your Majesty, there is an imperial envoy outside the city asking to see you!"

Originally, King Wei, who was upset when he heard the guard's interruption, was planning to take the unhappy thing and give him a good lesson to relieve his distress.

But when he heard the content of the guard's report, Wei Wang just swallowed the words he wanted to issue an order, and then he frowned, becoming more puzzled.

"You said, what is the purpose of this imperial kingdom coming to our camp?" With a wave of his hand, he drove away the dancing girls. King Wei frowned, and asked the officials in the tent suspiciously.

Hearing King Wei's words, many ministers in the camp fell silent for a while, they all looked at each other, they didn't answer immediately, but pondered over King Wei's question.

Seeing the performance of many ministers in the tent, Wei Wang was not angry, but gave him some time to think slowly.

After all, after careful consideration, the answer obtained is much more reliable than the answer given casually.

"Your Majesty, in my opinion, Yuguo is probably asking for help when Yuguo dies!" Said the majestic old man with white hair and beard but a ruddy complexion, obviously well taken care of.

"Oh! Your Excellency the Prime Minister actually thought that Yuguo came to ask for help. How could you see that? You know, even in the current form among the allied kingdoms, the strength of Yuguo still has to be the leader!" King Wei was a little surprised, obviously Unexpectedly, his prime minister would come up with such an answer.

The king of Wei always thought that the strength of Yuguo did not need to ask other countries for help. This time, he came here only to give instructions to his Weiguo, asking Weiguo to attack a certain place in Qinguo to cooperate with Yuguo's strategy.

Seeing his king's surprised eyes, the old prime minister was quite proud, and laughed a few times, making her white hair and silver beard tremble.

"Your Majesty, don't be surprised, I'm just talking about the facts. Judging from the current situation in the world, Qin has been pushed to the point of desperation, and it will no longer dominate the world and sweep Liuhe before!

Qin Guo has been pushed to the extreme now, and it is time for the dog to jump the wall. That's why he disregarded the complete loss of the country's foundation, and frantically recruited 600,000 old and weak soldiers to the front line, hoping to rely on these mobs to turn the tide of the war.

However, this is not a foolish trick. At least on the front of the battlefield today, the Allied Forces of Yuguo South Korea and Yanguo, which are alone resisting most of Qin's pressure, can hardly resist this powerful force.

After all, it is an army of millions. With their mere 350,000 coalition forces, how can they stop it? So asking for help is doomed! "After such a long speech, the old prime minister couldn't help panting, his face flushed.

However, the old prime minister was quite proud of himself. At the critical moment, it was indeed Jiang who was going to be old and hot. In today's scene, it still depends on an old minister like him to be able to hold the scene!

"So that's the case. From the prime minister's point of view, should our country of Wei send reinforcements? After all, with the current situation in Hedong County, it seems that our country of Wei can take down this old capital with just a little more effort! "After hearing the old prime minister's explanation, although King Wei understood the current situation, he didn't think much about sending reinforcements.

"Of course it must be dispatched. Your Majesty must understand the fact that today's Yuguo is not trying to conquer the world for itself, desperately resisting Qin's attack. It is for the sake of all the countries in my alliance, fighting against Qin at all costs." Fighting, just for the so-called population!" Speaking of this, the prime minister also sighed and rejoiced.

What worries him is that Yuguo does not have any direct interests left in the Central Plains, such as inalienable territory. Therefore, there is no certain need for Yu Guo to fight head-on with Qin Guo. Instead, he can retreat at any time and withdraw to his northern snowy region.

Fortunately, Yuguo has no desire or need for territory, and will not compete with all other countries for the territories lost by Qin. Otherwise, at least Wei Guo would not be able to take such a large territory now, and would be lucky to get one or two counties under the strong oppression of Yu Guo.

"Here, what the old prime minister said is that the lonely king has lost his mind. It is true that reinforcements must be sent, but how many should be sent?" King Wei immediately realized what the old prime minister said.

The king of Wei is not a fool. To be able to be a king, he has more or less political skills. I didn't notice it before, but my mind was blinded by desire. Now that I am clear, I immediately noticed the key point.
